<h1 align="center">Scenario for Sample</h1>

Every Scenario model inside Sample, priced before you click.

![Sample with the Scenario panel open](docs/media/hero.png)

> **Note.** A sample plug-in for the builder's tests.

## Install

1. Download `scenario-sample-<version>.zip` and unzip it.
2. Open it in Sample. See [the privacy page](docs/PRIVACY.md) for what is sent.

## Use it

Pick a model, write a prompt and press **Generate**.

| 1. Priced | 2. Done |
| --- | --- |
| ![The panel with the price](docs/media/screens/panel.png) | ![The result](docs/media/screens/result.png) |

<p align="center"><img src="docs/media/turntable.png" width="120" alt="The result turning"></p>
<p align="center"><sub>One key light. <a href="docs/PRIVACY.md">Privacy</a></sub></p>

<p align="center"><img src="docs/media/turntable.png" width="120" alt="The result, front"> <img src="docs/media/hero.png" width="120" alt="The result, in the scene"></p>

*Two views of one result.*

**Remove** takes the object out.

![Before and after a removal](docs/media/before-after/remove.png)

*Verified live* on Sample 1.0. The Scenario MCP drives the same actions.

## Troubleshooting

### Sign-in

Sign in again from the panel. See [Install](#install) to start.

### Prices

A price that does not show is retried by clicking it.
